cohort: 8758 singleton deliveries >36 completed weeks' gestation at a UK teaching hospital over a 4.5 year period
finding: Despite a lower mean cord arterial pH and greater incidence of fetal distress in males, intrapartum hypoxia does not fully account for their worse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: While male infants had lower mean cord arterial pH and a higher incidence of fetal distress, mode of delivery was not found to be significantly associated with these outcomes.
